fifteen-minute-reversal.description: Does the next fifteen-minute bitcoin window on Polymarket reverse the last one? It did 50.7% of the time, interval 48.4% to 53.0%, which contains a coin flip.

number.note: checked by the audit: its checker compared this cell (run 3, 2026-10-25)

fifteen-minute-reversal.caption: Reversal rate with its 95% interval, against a coin flip at 50%.

logical-arbitrage.description: Related markets on Polymarket must price consistently. A scan of 860 events found five real gaps, and none could fill the order size tested. Cause: capacity.

number.note: the audit's checker compared 270,232 values across all 53 ideas (run 3, 2026-10-25); this number is not one of them: it is a count from the case's own result table

logical-arbitrage.caption: The 860 events scanned, one dot each; the eight raw opportunities; the five real ones; none that could fill a 500-dollar order.

novig-favorites.description: Do heavy favorites on Novig win more often than their price says? Scored outcomes beat breakeven by 3.95 points, but 43.7% could not be scored, and not at random.

number.rest: points, interval 0.44 to 7.01, scored outcomes only
number.sr: +3.95 points, interval 0.44 to 7.01, scored outcomes only
number.note: the audit's checker compared 270,232 values across all 53 ideas (run 3, 2026-10-25); this number is not one of them: it is the gap between two values it did compare

novig-favorites.caption: Above: how far the win rate beat breakeven on the scored outcomes, with its interval, in points. Below: the share of outcomes that could not be scored. The tested price band is withheld.

pump-graduation.description: Buy a pump.fun memecoin five minutes after it graduates, sell at sixty. Over 4,158 replayed round trips the mean net return was -53.5% per trade, interval -55.8% to -50.9%.

number.note: checked by the audit: its checker compared this cell (run 3, 2026-10-25)

pump-graduation.caption: Mean net return per trade, buying five minutes after graduation and selling at sixty. Dots are the means, lines the 95% intervals, the grey line is break even. The larger-pool row is an exploratory cut.
